beats.text: Your date lied on their profile. Eighty-one percent do.
Researchers met eighty online daters in person, measured their height and weight, and checked their ID.
Eighty-one percent had fudged at least one: height, weight, or age.
Women tended to shave off pounds. Men tended to add inches.
But the lies were small. About five pounds, a third of an inch, a few months.
Small enough to get away with. Big enough to feel better. Be honest. Did you?

sources: Toma, Hancock & Ellison (2008). Separating fact from fiction: An examination of deceptive self-presentation in online dating profiles. Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin 34(8). 80 online daters (NYC), height/weight measured, age from driver's license; 81% misreported at least one; average discrepancies ~5-6 lb, ~1/3 inch, ~5 months; women understated weight, men overstated height. Via CBS News.
